source.author: verg
source.text: conveniunt, quibus aut odium crudele tyranni aut metus acer erat; navis, quae forte paratae, corripiunt, onerantque auro: portantur avari Pygmalionis opes pelago; dux femina facti.
source.text_original: conveniunt, quibus aut odium crudele tyranni / aut metus acer erat; navis, quae forte paratae, / corripiunt, onerantque auro: portantur avari / Pygmalionis opes pelago; dux femina facti.
source.text_english: Those assemble who either had savage hatred of the tyrant or sharp fear; they seize the ships, which happened to be ready, and load them with gold: the riches of avaricious Pygmalion are borne over the sea; a woman is leader of the deed.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quamquam illa inito semel matrimonio nihil aliud diebus ac noctibus cogitauit, nisi ut reddito fructu nuptiarum secundum castimoniae gradum arriperet et, tanti dux femina facti, uirum proposito suo iungeret non relinquens salutis comitem, sed expectans.
reuse.text_original: quamquam illa inito semel matrimonio nihil aliud diebus ac noctibus cogitauit, nisi ut reddito fructu nuptiarum secundum castimoniae gradum arriperet et, tanti dux femina facti, uirum proposito suo iungeret non relinquens salutis comitem, sed expectans.
reuse.text_english: although once she had entered marriage she thought of nothing else by day and by night except that, once the fruit of marriage had been restored, she might seize the second step of chastity; and, leader of so great a deed, though a woman, she joined a husband to her purpose, not abandoning a companion in salvation but waiting for him.
